title: Generate Pick and Place files from the project
summary: Gets the focused project's Pick Place outputer by its output type with IProject.DM_Outputers and writes its files into a folder with DM_Generate_OutputFilesTo, without an Output Job document; lists the files written.
phrasings: export a pick and place file
run a configured project output into a folder

commands.name: Generate
commands.description: Generate the focused project's Pick Place output files
